name: RHIM
description: RHIM (Redundant Hypothesis Identification in Mathematics) is the first benchmark for evaluating redundant hypothesis detection in mathematical proof problems. It comprises 200 problems with verified ground truth and measures the ability of models to detect, identify, and verify redundant hypotheses in mathematical reasoning.
reputation: A niche but novel benchmark in mathematical reasoning that has attracted interest for probing proof-level hypothesis understanding.
notes: Focuses on logical dependencies in mathematical proofs; reveals significant gaps in current LLM reasoning capabilities.
